finalists.label: Polymyalgia Rheumatica
finalists.why: It has the strongest for evidence, including elevated inflammatory markers and bilateral iliacus and iliopsoas muscle oedema with enhancement.

finalists.label: Sepsis
finalists.why: It has some for evidence, including low blood pressure and elevated inflammatory markers, but the against evidence is strong, including unremarkable chest X-ray, atypical pneumonia serology, and urine microscopy and culture.

finalists.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis
finalists.why: It has some for evidence, including elevated inflammatory markers and bilateral iliacus and iliopsoas muscle oedema with enhancement, but it is less specific than Polymyalgia Rheumatica.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is decided by the specific evidence of bilateral iliacus and iliopsoas muscle oedema with enhancement, which is more specific to Polymyalgia Rheumatica than to Rheumatoid Arthritis.
